# CAPTURED from a Keebart Sofle Choc Pro BT, left half, over USB, on macOS, on 2026-10-23,
# by the spike S1 harness (KEY-8). The firmware is Keebart's, as shipped. It calls itself
# "Sofle Choc Pro", and Raise has `&kp N0` on key 22, so it was built from Keebart/zmk-config
# between 2025-11-24 and 2026-02-12, against ZMK v0.3 or ZMK's main branch of that time.
#
# A session over USB: probe, a locked keyboard, the unlock, every behavior, a settings reset
# back to the stock keymap, the keymap and the physical layout, then an edit that is
# discarded. The keyboard sends its replies in chunks of up to 32 bytes.
